claim_boundary: Retypes the canonical A6-to-A7 rung from the owner-authored realization-fiber specification. It does not construct the G4 realization fiber or classify its components.

A6.role: law of compositions / SCC profile a

A7.object_kind: groupoid-valued fiber C_a of realizations c with alpha(c)=a

C1_6.object_kind: fiber or moduli construction, not a linear state map

retyping_consequences.prior: V1 = Hilbert state carrier for A6
retyping_consequences.retyped: V1 is the abstract law/profile datum a; any Hilbert carrier belongs to a realization c

retyping_consequences.prior: V2 = finite radial carrier identified with A7
retyping_consequences.retyped: the finite radial carrier is a candidate object c in C_a, not the fiber groupoid C_a itself

retyping_consequences.prior: T_real is a matrix from an A6 basis to an A7 basis
retyping_consequences.retyped: C1_6 constructs or compares the fiber of realizations over a; intertwiners T live between objects c,d inside that fiber

retyping_consequences.prior: the radial Green form is edge E24 of the canonical A6/A7 tetrahedron
retyping_consequences.retyped: the Green form is internal structure on a realization and a preservation condition on fiber morphisms

retyping_consequences.prior: A6dual is a Hilbert response dual
retyping_consequences.retyped: a dual at the profile/fiber level must first be defined as tests, predicates, or probes on laws and realization groupoids; Hilbert duality does not lift automatically

placement_of_current_finite_evidence.reciprocal_sewing: named constructor or instrument transition internal to c
placement_of_current_finite_evidence.missing_for_A7: a second realization d or a classified automorphism/intertwiner family, plus triangle and higher coherence

disposition.previous_variance_tetrahedron_status: valid only as a candidate internal chart of one realization after its four endpoints and cells are independently sourced; not yet the canonical A6-to-A7 tower geometry
disposition.first_executable_test: place the finite radial candidate in one declared SCC profile and test its automorphism/intertwiner groupoid requirements
disposition.first_missing_typed_datum: the exact profile map alpha(c)=a for the radial candidate
